content.title: CBSE 10th Class Result 2026 Link Out cbse.gov.in - Check Details Here
content.text: The Central Board of Secondary Education announced the CBSE 10th result for Phase 1 on April 15, 2026. Candidates who appeared for the CBSE 10th board examination can access their results through the official website, DigiLocker, SMS, IVRS, etc. They can visit the official website at results.digilocker.gov.in or cbseresults.nic.in. They must enter their roll number, school number, admit card ID, date of birth, and security pin in the result login window to access and download their CBSE 10th result.CBSE 10th Result 2026 Link This Story also ContainsHighlights of the CBSE Class 10 Result 2026 Phase 1How to Access and Download the CBSE 10th Result 2026 Online?Information Mentioned in the 10th Class CBSE Result 2026CBSE 10th Board Result 2026 Statistics CBSE 10th Class Result 2026 Link Out Today cbse.gov.in - Check Details Here Students need to score at least 33% of marks to pass the board examination. The online result is provisional in nature. Students can collect the original marksheet from their respective schools later. Read the article to learn more about the CBSE 10th result 2026.
